第42章 女士内衣，买买买！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

李拓蒙了，随后疯狂掏自己的口袋，拿出一个暗红色小本本。

“你看！我们是同胞！我真是退伍的！”

看到红本上鲜明的标志，方芸动容了。

“许默，就让他跟我们回去吧，让他捡两天木头就好了！”

许默无奈叹气。

回到营地，已经是下午，洞内漆黑。

营地壁炉的火疯狂跳动，将三人的影子拉长。

经过商量，许默和方芸轮班睡觉，防着李拓，李拓可以在这里住两夜，灰雾小晶体就算是他的房租，但管住不管吃。

李拓感激的痛哭流涕。

“那灰色晶体也没用！我全都给你，感谢你们的再造之恩啊！”

许默轻笑道，心里却是乐翻了。

“言重了！”

进入系统界面，果然！

一个灰色小晶体，换10点幸存值。

他手上，灰色小晶体过千，直接兑换！

只一瞬间，便拥有上万幸运值！

当晚，李拓睡地上，许默前半夜不睡觉，在交易行里大肆扫货。

木材？

谁特么愿意天天砍树啊......

白面！买！

冲锋衣，防护服！全买！

女士内衣，买买买！

男士内裤？我觉得还能再忍忍！

卫生巾先弄十盒存货。

卫生纸和饮用水全都备着！

一夜之间挥霍几千幸存值。

而李拓，倒计时九小时的时候他就睡死了，整整一夜，呼噜震天！

第二天，李拓无言的出去采集材料。

许默和方芸则是忙着修复营地。

最关键的是，许默手上的材料提前准备好了，几乎爆仓，任何修复都是直接提交，无需采集。

晚上，李拓跑回了营地。

看见许默和方芸早就开始煮面了。

面香味顺着白气飘过来，他咽了口唾沫。

许默打趣问到。

“呦！李班长回来了？收成咋样啊？”

李拓一脸尴尬的说道。

“33单位，还差......60就够我重建营地了，今天方向不对，我明天换个方位，使使劲，肯定能修好！”

许默叹了口气。

“没事，你付了房钱了，一天33木头不少了！”

“来吧，老李，吃一口，别据着了！”

Li Tuo was confused, then frantically dug into his pocket and took out a small dark red notebook.

"Look! We are compatriots! I am really a veteran!"

Fang Yun was moved when she saw the bright mark on the red book.

"Xu Mo, just let him go back with us and let him pick up wood for two days!"

Xu Mo sighed helplessly.

Back at the camp, it was already afternoon and the cave was dark.

The fire in the camp fireplace beat wildly, lengthening the shadows of the three people.

After discussion, Xu Mo and Fang Yun took turns sleeping to guard against Li Tuo. Li Tuo could stay here for two nights, and the Gray Mist Crystal would be his rent, but he would not have to live or eat.

Li Tuo cried with gratitude.

"That gray crystal is useless! I'll give it all to you. Thank you for your kindness in recreating it!"

Xu Mo chuckled, but his heart was filled with joy.

"Serious words!"

Entering the system interface, sure enough!

A small gray crystal can be exchanged for 10 survival points.

He has over a thousand small gray crystals in his hand, so he can exchange them directly!

In just one moment, you have tens of thousands of lucky points!

That night, Li Tuo slept on the floor, while Xu Mo stayed up half the night and went shopping in the trading house.

wood?

Who the hell wants to cut down trees every day...

White noodles!purchase!

Jacket, protective clothing!Buy them all!

Women's underwear, buy, buy, buy!

Men's underwear?I think I can endure it any longer!

First get ten boxes of sanitary napkins in stock.

Toilet paper and drinking water are all prepared!

Thousands of survival points were squandered overnight.

As for Li Tuo, he fell asleep when the nine-hour countdown began. He snored loudly all night long!

The next day, Li Tuo silently went out to collect materials.

Xu Mo and Fang Yun were busy repairing the camp.

The most important thing is that the materials on Xu Mo's hand are prepared in advance, almost bursting out of stock, and any repairs are submitted directly without collection.

At night, Li Tuo ran back to the camp.

Xu Mo and Fang Yun were seen cooking noodles long ago.

The aroma of noodles floated along the white air, and he swallowed.

Xu Mo asked jokingly.

"Hey! Squad Leader Li is back? How was the harvest?"

Li Tuo said with an embarrassed look.

"33 units, still less... 60 is enough for me to rebuild the camp. The direction is wrong today. I will change the direction tomorrow and use my strength. I will definitely be able to fix it!"

Xu Mo sighed.

"It's okay, you paid the rent, 33 a day is a lot of wood!"

"Come on, Lao Li, take a bite and don't hold on to it!"
